webhooks.detail: Native webhooks: topics for coupons, customers, orders, products (created/updated/deleted) plus custom Action topics; delivered to a URL you choose.

evidence.quote: A webhook is an event notification sent to a URL of your choice.

sandbox.detail: No hosted sandbox. WooCommerce is free, self-hosted software, so devs run a free local WordPress+WooCommerce site (e.g. Studio) and generate API keys there. Playground not confirmed in docs.

evidence.quote: Studio starts the local site and gives you its URL.

rate_limits.summary: REST API: none documented. Store API only: optional, off by default, 25 requests per 10 s (POST only).

evidence.quote: A default maximum of 25 requests can be made within a 10-second time frame.
Use /wp-json/wc/v3/ endpoints for all new integrations.
